mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! Imagine a world where curiosity knows no limits, where creativity and the hunger for knowledge spark discoveries that still amaze us centuries later. That's exactly the journey we're about to take together, guided by Walter Isaacson’s vivid storytelling—bringing the life of Leonardo da Vinci into sharp, fascinating focus. Picture Leonardo, not just as a master artist, but as someone who dissected cadavers, sketched out wild flying machines, and filled notebook after notebook with questions and ideas. He didn’t rely on talent alone; it was his relentless observation and fearless experiments that set him apart. As we explore his story, you’ll see how Leonardo’s mix of art and science became a kind of superpower—and how curiosity can break down boundaries we might never have noticed. Isaacson helps us look at Leonardo’s life not just as a biography, but as an invitation to think differently, to welcome uncertainty, and to keep asking those questions that everyone else overlooks. So, if you’re ready to peek inside the mind of a true genius and discover how curiosity can shape the world, you’re in the right place. Let’s step into Leonardo’s world together, and see what wonders we can uncover.
